svg.title: Benchmark baseline
svg.desc: Strip plot of per-run throughput for five workloads, core and replay.
svg.text: Benchmark baseline: every run, before optimization
Throughput of each run of 100,000 timed commands, 90 runs per row (3 sessions × 30). Each dot is one run; the bar is the median.
Recorded 2026-10-25 on one machine (Ryzen 5 5600G, MSVC Release). Higher is faster.
replay: the same commands as in-memory CSV through the replay engine
Replay sits near 1 Mops/s on every workload: CSV parsing and event collection cost about 600 ns per command, 1.5–4× the engine's own cost.
The large-book core rows scatter widely (CV 11–22%), so later changes were judged by interleaved A/B pairs, not against these runs.
